No bend radius is qualified for the selected harness.
Do not bend at the housing or use conductors for unplugging.
Strap load -> shell-mounted clamp -> slack/service section -> plug; keep the outer tightening strap load out of the PCB.
Clamps/grommets, pull loads, fatigue cycles, and cutout tolerances require the separate enclosure/harness design.
